trajectory_comparison: immediately previous actual delivered source, starting from each study own selected parent
restoration_policy: F includes verified restoration after a previous FULL omission; report restored versus first-ever completed separately and retain prior regression penalties; unchanged old proofs do not count as a new repair. No union of answers.
missing_rounds: fixed denominator three; unknown is not mathematical zero and never renormalized
false_complete_claim: diagnosis zero plus explicit major false-completeness event; verified repair contribution retained
delivery_and_math: complete means verified submitted mathematical obligation, not the truth value of the original theorem; failed source delivery and false mathematical claims remain separate

primary_sources.terra: first archived engineering project and each followup archived engineering project
primary_sources.gemini: final archived project within the shared 180-minute first-answer budget and each followup archived engineering project

complete_definition: Actually submitted and independently reviewed complete and correct mathematical obligation, including its semantic correspondence.
presentation_note: Some equivalent tests inherit existing benchmark responses; full source details are kept separately.
change_scope: Unified sealed-engineering source review for all four formalization tasks in both models; capability weights and alignment selfcheck points/penalties unchanged.

formalization_source_policy.original_response: retained verbatim for self-assessment and delivery comparison
formalization_source_policy.semantic_completion: independently reviewed obligations in the unchanged submitted source; no proof repairs, best-of or cross-round union
formalization_source_policy.mapping_defects: reported separately; evaluator correspondence is explicitly labeled and never substituted for a model claim
